marketLayer.title: US Semiconductor & AI Infrastructure Momentum
marketLayer.fact: Major US chipmakers and cloud hyperscalers saw increased institutional inflows following upgraded capital expenditure forecasts dedicated to AI server buildouts and next-generation architecture.
marketLayer.inference: Sustained high capex commitments from tech titans validate medium-term demand for AI hardware, driving valuation expansion across the Nasdaq semiconductor chain.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Risk of margin compression if monetization of AI software services lags behind the massive capital investment cycle.

marketLayer.title: HK Internet Giants Share Repurchase Programs
marketLayer.fact: Leading Hong Kong-listed tech leaders executed significant daily share buybacks totaling over HKD 1.5 billion, providing downside support to the Hang Seng Tech Index during intra-day volatility.
marketLayer.inference: Aggressive corporate repurchase actions signal strong cash reserves and management confidence in valuation bottoms, helping to stabilize broader market sentiment.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Persistently weak domestic consumer sentiment impacting underlying quarterly e-commerce and digital advertising revenue growth.

marketLayer.title: Federal Reserve Rate Cut Trajectory & Yield Environment
marketLayer.fact: Recent US inflation and labor market data releases reinforce expectations for an upcoming Federal Reserve interest rate reduction, leading to a pull-back in 10-year US Treasury yields.
marketLayer.inference: Easing risk-free yields improve equity risk premiums globally, offering liquidity relief to high-valuation growth sectors in both US and Hong Kong markets.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Potential resurging inflationary pressure stemming from global supply chain disruptions or commodity price volatility.

marketLayer.title: Chinese New Energy Vehicle (NEV) Delivery Expansion
marketLayer.fact: Dual-listed Chinese NEV manufacturers posted robust monthly delivery growth metrics driven by mid-year promotion drives and expanding export shipments to overseas markets.
marketLayer.inference: Strong volume expansion continues to drive top-line revenues, encouraging selective re-rating of top-tier automakers with strong supply chain integration.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Ongoing domestic price wars eroding gross profit margins and escalating international tariff risks in European and North American markets.
